title: model-bindings.v1 — capability-tier → model/effort bindings for engine personas
description: The single committed file that maps a persona's capability tier (model-tier: judgment or mechanical — the name-free demand vocabulary the personas already declare) to the model alias and reasoning effort that realize it, with per-persona overrides. This is how the engine selects models without naming a model in any persona file: personas stay capability-shaped, and which model realizes a tier is the evolving judgment kept HERE, in one place, so retuning for a new model landscape is one file edit re-rendered across every persona. Model values are durable aliases only (opus, sonnet, fable, …), never a versioned id that rots — the pattern rejects digits so a pinned dated id cannot be committed, while the engine names no closed set of aliases (a new model is adopted by changing a value, never the grammar). The per-persona overrides express a mixed-by-lens scheme — a deep or adversarial lens on a stronger model, a systematic lens a tier down — as the operator's tuning. Retuning is the operator's own act: edit this file and re-run agent_bindings.py render.

schema_version.description: Which version of this file's shape this is. Today the only valid value is 1.

tiers.description: The default binding for each capability tier. Both tiers are always present: judgment (careful reasoning) and mechanical (bounded work). A persona with no override inherits its tier's binding.

overrides.description: Per-persona bindings, keyed by the persona's name (its .claude/agents/<name>.md slug). An override wins over the persona's tier default — this is how a specific lens is tuned to a stronger or cheaper model without changing its declared capability tier. A key that names no installed persona is a stale override, caught by the agent-bindings coherence test.

binding.description: One model + effort pairing that realizes a capability demand.

model.description: A durable model alias — lowercase letters and hyphens only, NO digits, so a versioned id that rots (claude-opus-4-20250101) cannot be committed while any durable alias (opus, sonnet, haiku, fable) is accepted. The engine names no closed set of aliases.

effort.description: The reasoning-effort level that, with the model, realizes the tier. A bounded platform concept.
